weekly_pulse:
Weekly Product Pulse — 21 Oct 2026
*12,651 Play Store reviews, 29 Jul–20 Oct 2026 (avg 4.4★)*

Top themes (by low-rated volume)
1. Support, withdrawals, payments & KYC — 594 reviews, 2.44★
2. App performance & order execution — 606 reviews, 2.75★
3. Fees, brokerage & unexpected charges — 358 reviews, 2.34★

Praise centres on ease of use (1,456 reviews, 4.81★).

User voices
- "worst app. they take charges and the processing of money withdrawal is too slow. Not even chat support is helpful. don't install it."
- "Stop loss , Target price won't work when you need it. It stops working or won't be executed if the user volume is too high"
- "Charges were deducted from my account without clear information or proper notification beforehand."

Key observation
Users like the interface; frustration clusters around money movement and cost. Of 358 fee-related reviews, 255 are 3★ or below, and about 78 describe charges as unclear or unexpected, mainly total deductions exceeding the stated ₹20 brokerage. Fee mentions hold steady at 2.7–3% of monthly reviews: persistent, not a spike.

Action ideas
1. Show an itemised charge breakdown (brokerage, taxes, DP, square-off) before and after each order.
2. Add a withdrawal/payment status tracker with proactive failure alerts to cut support load.
3. Audit stop-loss and target order execution under high volume.
identified_fee_issue: Brokerage and additional per-order charges: users report total deductions exceeding the stated ₹20 brokerage and describe charges as unclear or unexpected (358 fee-related reviews, about 78 citing unclear/unexpected deductions)
explanation_bullets: Brokerage is Groww's per-order fee: ₹20 or 0.1% of the order value, whichever is lower, with a ₹5 minimum.
Statutory and exchange charges apply on top of brokerage: STT, exchange transaction charges, SEBI turnover fees and stamp duty. These are set by the government, regulator or exchange, not by Groww.
18% GST applies to brokerage and to several other charges, including exchange transaction, SEBI turnover and DP charges.
Selling delivery shares incurs a DP charge (₹16.5 per sell transaction, ₹0 if the debit value is under ₹100) plus a depository fee and GST. Intraday DP charge is ₹0.
Event-based charges also exist, such as ₹50 per position when open intraday positions are auto squared-off, and delayed payment charges of 0.05% per day.
Because several charges apply per order and per side, the total deducted on a trade can exceed the ₹20 brokerage alone. Groww's help page explains each charge shown in the report.

CUSTOMER SUPPORT SNIPPET

• Brokerage is Groww's per-order fee: ₹20 or 0.1% of the order value, whichever is lower, with a ₹5 minimum.
• Statutory and exchange charges apply on top of brokerage: STT, exchange transaction charges, SEBI turnover fees and stamp duty. These are set by the government, regulator or exchange, not by Groww.
• 18% GST applies to brokerage and to several other charges, including exchange transaction, SEBI turnover and DP charges.
• Selling delivery shares incurs a DP charge (₹16.5 per sell transaction, ₹0 if the debit value is under ₹100) plus a depository fee and GST. Intraday DP charge is ₹0.
• Event-based charges also exist, such as ₹50 per position when open intraday positions are auto squared-off, and delayed payment charges of 0.05% per day.
• Because several charges apply per order and per side, the total deducted on a trade can exceed the ₹20 brokerage alone. Groww's help page explains each charge shown in the report.
